name: Send or Delete
description: A social guessing game. Each round is a fictional post. The room decides whether the featured person would publish it.
rules: Two choices: SEND or DELETE. Read the chirp, take guesses, then reveal the answer. Elimination is optional. Turn it off in the formats list if you only want points.
introScript: I will read a post. You tell me whether they would send it or delete it.
closingScript: That is the last chirp. I will name the winner after I check the scores.
hostNotes: The chirp lives in extras.chirp so a new game can use a different label without a plugin update.

extras.chirp: I don't have a gil problem. I have a very expensive sense of personal style.

rounds.title: Morning
rounds.explanation: Replace the answer and the staff name when you copy this into an event.

extras.chirp: I woke up early, watered every plant, and then went back to bed.
